mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, parent_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.member_id, m.profile_id, c.content, c.created_at, c.deleted_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at_str, m.nickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m USING (member_id) WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.comment_id) DESC, c.parent_id IS NOT NULL, c.comment_id ASC
SELECT comment_id, post_id, parent_id FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
